name: code-skeptic-scanner-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end layer for Code Skeptic Scanner, driven by its own self-contained Vite harness. Every script names a local binary, no script downloads a browser, and browsers:require is the fail-closed gate that resolves the one it launches. What each script does: e2e/README.md sections 2 and 3. Why any of it is shaped this way: docs/testing/DECISION-LOG.md rows D111, D129, D236, D252, D254, D264 (superseded by D300) and D361.
